# TL Live Auction Dashboard

> Real-time lot indexing, out-of-pocket total cost calculation, savings estimates, and custom watchlist management.

## Overview
The TL Live Auction Dashboard indexes active items across Raleigh and South Carolina locations, providing automated total financial calculations (buyer's premium, NC/SC sales tax, credit card fees, out-of-pocket totals) and catalog filtering.

## Usage Policy & Crawler Guidelines
- Automated indexing of auction lots for user interface display is managed by the application backend.
- Automated data harvesting or training datasets via AI bots is not permitted without explicit authorization (see robots.txt).
